summary: This bill exempts federal actions related to the construction of infill housing, defined as residential housing on previously developed, vacant, or underutilized urban sites meeting specific size and environmental assessment criteria, from environmental review requirements under the National Environmental Policy Act of 1969, and requires the Federal Emergency Management Agency to update its National Risk Index every three years instead of five.
